'''The 2026 World Championship Cube Draft''', billed as '''Throdo’s Cube Spectacular!''', was a [[Cube]] side event at the [[2026 World Championship]]. It took place on 23 October 2026 at the Hyatt Regency by Mall of America in Bloomington, Minnesota.<ref name="cube26-schedule">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=86982 2026 World Championship Schedule of Events], [[Players Committee]] forum, Chris Schoenthal (imrahil327), 14 September 2026. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261114004451/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t86982.html Internet Archive].</ref> Twelve players entered.<ref name="cube26-start">Star Wars CCG Slack, #2026-worlds-mpls, Chris Schoenthal (imrahil327), 23 October 2026: “Cube has begun! A nice even 12”, with photographs IMG_0107 and IMG_0108.</ref> [[Chris Wirfs]] and [[Garrett Larson]] both finished 4–0 and agreed to split the prize money; Wirfs had the better strength of schedule and received first choice of prizes.<ref name="cube26-results">Star Wars CCG Slack, #2026-worlds-mpls, KrazyKarl, 27 October 2026, reply to Gogolen’s request for Friday Cube results: “Garrett and Wirfs both went 4-0. They agree to chop the money”; Garrett Larson (deadbody), same thread, 27 October 2026, on Chris Wirfs’s strength of schedule and first choice of prizes.</ref>

== Format ==

* '''Format:''' [[Cube]]<ref name="cube26-schedule" />

The schedule called for four Swiss games, two with each side of the Force, with all supplies provided. Registration was scheduled for 11:30 a.m. and play for noon. Entry cost $10 on site or $5 in advance and was included in the Worlds weekend pass.<ref name="cube26-schedule" />
